distribution.summary: 中国大陆（区域记录，未细化至省级）；台湾
distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) gives the source distribution as China (SW); Taiwan and reports the first Taiwan record from Ilan, Fushan and Nantou, Huison. China (SW) is retained as broad source evidence and is not expanded into province-level records.

host_note: The source explicitly reports Lithocarpus edulis and Quercus myrsinaefolia; both are retained at species level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes graniceps (Eichhoff, 1877).
